propositions: DC transport raises JIRAError but core catch clauses only handle urllib.error.HTTPError, causing DC failures to escape unhandled while Cloud HTTP errors degrade gracefully
outbound_differ._safe_get_issue misclassifies remotely-deleted DC issues because JIRAError does not match the 404 detection logic, breaking deletion detection silently on DC
BackendHTTPError must be declared as a subclass of urllib.error.HTTPError on the port to serve as a neutral exception contract that every backend must raise
DC transport must translate JIRAError to BackendHTTPError at the adapter boundary, preserving HTTP status codes so existing core catch clauses continue working without modification

Core modules (dispatch_apply_phases.py and outbound_differ.py) must remain unmodified because BackendHTTPError IS-A urllib.error.HTTPError and matches existing exception handlers by subclass relationship
